title: 2026 UK air-pollutant emissions statistics QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Emissions of air pollutants in the UK - Summary

sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Emissions of air pollutants in the UK - Background

facts.source_fact: Defra publishes annual accredited statistics on emissions of important air pollutants.
facts.expected_handling: Attach publication vintage.

facts.source_fact: The current release was updated on 12 February 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use the 2026 edition for current comparisons.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 release reports long-term emissions trends through 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer 2025 or 2026 emissions from the trend series.

facts.source_fact: The release includes nitrogen oxides emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep pollutant identity separate.

facts.source_fact: The release includes ammonia emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep pollutant identity separate.

facts.source_fact: The release includes non-methane volatile organic compound emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat NMVOC as methane.

facts.source_fact: The release includes sulphur dioxide emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep pollutant identity separate.

facts.source_fact: The release includes PM10 and PM2.5 emissions sections.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat particulate mass as gaseous GHG.

facts.source_fact: The summary reports progress against emission-reduction commitments.
facts.expected_handling: Keep commitment assessment distinct from raw emissions.

facts.source_fact: The release separates recent trends from long-term trends.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the comparison window.

facts.source_fact: The release identifies notable sources of emissions in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Do not generalise source shares to other years.

facts.source_fact: The background explains how UK air-pollutant emission figures are calculated.
facts.expected_handling: Carry inventory-method provenance.

facts.source_fact: Emissions inventories measure quantities released, not ambient air concentrations.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute emissions for air-quality concentration data.

facts.source_fact: The background explains links between pollutant emissions and UK air quality.
facts.expected_handling: Keep emissions and concentration indicators distinct.

facts.source_fact: The publication discusses health and environmental impacts of air pollution.
facts.expected_handling: Do not convert impact context into emissions measurements.

facts.source_fact: The release is accredited official statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Use accreditation as quality context.

facts.source_fact: The statistics are produced under Code of Practice standards for trustworthiness, quality and value.
facts.expected_handling: Do not interpret accreditation as error-free permanence.

facts.source_fact: Official statistics can be revised as inventory evidence and methods improve.
facts.expected_handling: Version source data.

facts.source_fact: The air-quality and emissions statistics collection provides the ENV01 emissions dataset alongside the release.
facts.expected_handling: Keep publication and dataset versions aligned.

facts.source_fact: Air-pollutant statistics are a different inventory domain from greenhouse-gas accounting even where sources overlap.
facts.expected_handling: Do not combine pollutant and GHG totals.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
